blocks.text: An Office of the Ombudsman investigator testified before the Sandiganbayan on Wednesday that Uswag Partylist Rep. Jojo Ang had a 5 percent stake in a construction firm while serving as a lawmaker, citing records from the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
